programs.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Kenya"
programs.desc: Mt.Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker:High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion

programs.title: Angry Planet S2 - "By Camel to Timbuktu"
programs.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.

programs.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Indian Monsoon"
programs.desc: In June of next year we plan to intercept the Monsoon as it hits southern India and makes its way north along the western shore past Goa and Mumbai up to Delhi.This most famous of torrential rainy seasons drops as much as 40 feet of water.

programs.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "The Power of Water"
programs.desc: In this episode, we’ll see ways that water is the backbone of energy and resources in different areas across the planet.

programs.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Teens Making An Impact"
programs.desc: In this episode, we’ll meet teens that are working to make the planet a better place with innovative ideas and lots of hard work.

programs.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programs.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.
